skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding the nature of economic policies
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Grasp the essence of economic policies, approaches by economists, tasks of policymakers, goals of economic policies, and the system of economic policies.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding basic elements of economic policies
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Comprehend fundamental elements of economic policies, policy-making processes, forces involved in policy-making, and specific economic policies such as fiscal, monetary, tax, and structural policies.
Understand the basics of policy-making, implementation, monitoring, and evaluation according to outcome orientation.
Understand the activities in policy-making, implementation, and evaluation.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding the nature and role of activities in policy-making
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the nature and role of activities in policy-making, implementation, and evaluation.
Develop communication, presentation, conflict resolution, and time management skills.
Develop teamwork and group management skills.
Develop decision-making skills to solve policy issues.
Develop practical skills in policy-making, implementation, and evaluation.
Develop independent work, responsibility, social responsibility awareness, professional ethics, effective management of work capacity, and learning skills.
